# Fagron Academy

> Fagron Academy is a comprehensive continuing education platform for pharmacy professionals specializing in pharmaceutical compounding, sterile formulation, and USP compliance standards.

Fagron Academy provides accredited continuing education courses, technical support, and compounding resources through its FACTS portal and FACE e-learning platform. The academy serves pharmacy professionals seeking expertise in compounding pharmacy, USP <797>, <800>, and <795> standards, and professional development.

## Key Topics

- Pharmaceutical Compounding
- Sterile Formulation
- USP <797> Standards
- USP <800> Standards
- USP <795> Standards
- Continuing Education
- FACTS Portal
- FACE E-Learning
- Pharmacist Training
- Compounding Compliance
- Webinars
- Professional Development
- Pharmacy Education
- ACPE Accreditation
- GHK-Cu Peptides

## Continuing Education & Training

- [Fagron Academy Continuing Education (FACE)](https://www.fagronacademy.us/continuing-education): FACE e-learning courses, live labs, and webinars for pharmacy professionals
- [Events](https://www.fagronacademy.us/events): Fagron Academy workshops, webinars, and continuing education events
- [Faculty](https://www.fagronacademy.us/faculty): Fagron Academy faculty profiles with pharmaceutical compounding expertise

## Membership & Plans

- [Membership Plans](https://www.fagronacademy.us/plans): Fagron Academy tiered membership plans with training and database access
- [Partnerships](https://www.fagronacademy.us/partnerships): Fagron Academy industry partnerships and member benefit collaborations

## Compounding Resources & Support

- [FACTS Portal](https://www.fagronacademy.us/facts/home): FACTS portal with compounding formulas and pharmaceutical guidance
- [Compounding Technical Support](https://www.fagronacademy.us/compounding-technical-support): FACTS technical support for compounding formulations and USP compliance
